messages:
hannah: Quick sync re: OrionHealth POC — they want guidance on exchanging keys/certs for the Private VPC deployment. They asked if we can accept a wrapped key from their HSM or if we should generate a CSR on our side. Also raised daily cert rotation during the POC.

jamal: Recommend customer-managed KMS with BYOK for production. For short POC the lowest-friction option is: customer generates CSR with their HSM, signs it, and shares the cert chain + a wrapped key (PKCS#7 or KMIP wrapped) via a presigned S3 URL with 24h TTL. We should not accept raw private key PEMs.

mike: +1. Security constraints: do NOT accept private keys in the clear. Acceptable flows: 1) customer provides public cert + signed CSR (private key never leaves their HSM), or 2) provide a wrapped key using their HSM/KMS wrap algorithm (we unwrap only inside a customer-managed HSM or via approved vendor flow). For the POC we can accept signed cert chain + wrapped payload, but passphrase or unwrap key exchange must be out-of-band (voice call) and we must record key fingerprint. Also need Security Questionnaire updated (key handling section).

ben: On infra: for Private deployment we'll provision a dedicated pool in their VPC peered to our control plane. We'll create a service account 'poc-vault' with least privilege. Need the customer's KMS key ARN + an IAM role we can assume (or equivalent AWS cross-account principal) so we can perform the wrapped-key verification handshake. If they use vendor HSM (e.g., nCipher or Thales) we may require a vendor-specific import path.

clare: Pricing note: POC infra is covered but HSM/BYOK ingestion may have a one-time engineering/support fee if it requires custom import tooling. @hannah can you capture their target duration and expected QPS so we can size the Dedicated pool?

hannah: Customer says they prefer we generate a CSR and they will sign it with their HSM (so the private key never leaves). They will give us the signed cert chain and an OCSP staple. They asked if we can rotate certs daily during the POC — they want automated rotation testing.

jamal: Daily rotation is fine for POC. We'll create a small script to fetch the new cert, validate chain and fingerprint, perform a swap with a canary, and roll back on failures. Ask them to provide the cert chain plus the SHA256 fingerprint in hex. Example fingerprint format: 

```
sha256:4a:9f:3b:...:c1 (lowercase hex no spaces)
```

mike: Also: attach the minimal key-handling section of the security questionnaire in the email. For ingestion flows that include wrapped blobs, require the customer to provide the wrapping metadata (algorithm, salt/iv if applicable) and the key ACL. Do NOT accept unencrypted handoffs via email — use presigned URL or secure file transfer. Passphrases exchanged by phone only.

hannah: Customer contact is laura@orionhealth.com. I'll request: (a) KMS ARN or HSM vendor + import instructions, (b) cross-account IAM role or trust policy for key verification, (c) signed cert chain and SHA256 fingerprint, (d) confirmation on rotation cadence, (e) completed key-handling section of the secQ. Also asked about a minimal terraform snippet to create the role — creating that now. Snippet: 

```
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_poc_assume" {
  name = "redwood-poc-assume-role"
  assume_role_policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCUSTOMER:role/RedwoodPocTrust"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
POLICY
}
```

jamal: Looks good. Add a condition to restrict AssumeRole to the specific session name and to the account IDs we agree on. After they create the role we'll run a validation step that performs a dry-run unwrap (no private key storage) and records the fingerprint.

deploy-bot: deploy: created poc-vault-sa in project-redwood-poc at 1792001290 :white_check_mark:

ben: Confirming Dedicated pool: we'll spin up 'poc-orion-1' (2x A10G) for 2 weeks. @clare estimate: ~USD 9k infra cost. If they request extended retention of certs/logs or additional HSM import work, that'll add to the quote.

clare: I'll add the HSM ingestion line item to the quote and note 'engineering support required if custom vendor path'. Also will add a clause: 'Poc rotations > daily or extended key escrow > 2 weeks subject to additional fees'.

hannah: Action items consolidated: 1) ask Laura for KMS ARN/HSM vendor + IAM role, 2) request signed cert chain + sha256 fingerprint, 3) confirm desired rotation cadence and passphrase exchange procedure (phone), 4) send security questionnaire key-handling section and request return, 5) share terraform role snippet and request they create the role. I'll ping @jamal when artifacts arrive.

mike: :thumbsup: Ensure we log the cert/key fingerprint into the secrets audit and mark the key as "POC" with TTL. Also require mTLS for control-plane connections during the POC.

hannah: Will do. I'll follow up with Laura today and post updates here when I have them.

ben: Noted — infra ticket created: INFRA-2317.

clare: Thanks team.
